name: General Kerrigan
source:
General Kerrigan, soon to be Marshal Kerrigan, is an experienced leader of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]'s army. While skeptical at first, Kerrigan has embraced the MC as a leader he can follower. Kerrigan works well with others, but has no trouble making tough decisions.
